result:
I've rebuilt the homepage presentation and deployed it to a Vercel preview, but it is not at Sayable level yet. An independent reviewer that rejects by default rejected pass-02: it called the work clearly better than the baseline, but not at the Sayable bar.

**Preview:** https://betterdesk-redesign-8u64w2vv1-neel-s-projects9.vercel.app (commit `3b8c4f6`, recorded in the docs commit `8a56eba`). It's behind the Vercel login, so sign in to `neel-s-projects9` to view it. Signed in, `/`, `/pricing`, `/demo` and `/contact` return 200, and unknown routes return 404. Production and betterdesk.ai were not touched.

**What changed**
- **New look, "after hours, then morning":** the page opens on a near-black stage lit by one amber lamp and brightens into pearl as the call gets resolved. The old cream-and-serif look is gone. I switched the display font to Bricolage Grotesque and drew a new mark (amber signal rings closing onto a solid D), with a matching favicon.
- **Hero:** a missed call at 6:42 PM turns into a text thread, then a booking settles into a held slot on Thursday's schedule. The finished scene shows even before the animation plays. Phones get their own vertical layout with the product in the first screen.
- **Scroll story:** one conversation moves through five states (call, reply, questions, booked or handed to a person, owner inbox) on a pinned stage. A five-step progress rail runs through all of it. On phones each state shows inline, with nothing pinned.
- **Rest of the homepage:** reordered into night → evening → night story → pearl walkthrough → dark control section → pricing → a "morning" closing card. Subpages open with the same dark hero band. Small labels above headings are gone everywhere.
- **Hidden-content bug fixed:** in the old build, content started invisible and only appeared on scroll, which left long blank areas in full-page screenshots. Content is now always visible and only slides in.
- **Copy:** one new line, "Marco on the way", came out because the claims audit had already removed tech-arrival texts as unverified. Pricing and existing claims are unchanged.

**Checks**
- Types, lint, unit tests and the production build pass.
- Browser tests: 79 of 80 pass in Chromium and WebKit, including accessibility checks on every route.
- **One test still fails:** the reduced-motion hero check, which has flipped between browsers across runs. I haven't found the cause yet. I left the test in place and only repointed it at the booked card, because the animation moved there.
- I ran three screenshot → critique → fix loops at 320, 390, 768, 1440 and 1920px. Before, after and Sayable screenshots are in `docs/quality-v2/screenshots/`, each folder with a contact sheet.

**Limits this cycle**
- I couldn't stop the old overnight server on port 3917, so this work runs on 3918.
- The design skill's full visual-approval round needs someone at the keyboard, so I took the direction from your brief and noted that in `PRODUCT.md`.
- The design system file (`DESIGN.md`) isn't written yet.

**Still not done (cycle 2, from the review)**
- The story section reads as a dark void and needs tighter spacing and bigger content.
- The walkthrough phone still starts empty.
- The hero needs one clear focal object.
- Pricing, platform and demo still use the old page layouts below the new header band; the pricing hero has an empty right half.
- The ROI calculator hasn't been redesigned.
- The share image still uses the old cream design, and the mobile sticky booking bar is off-brand.
- Lighthouse and page-speed numbers for the new hero haven't been measured.

**Your calls**
- Is the night-to-morning direction right for BetterDesk?
- Do you want to keep the headline "Every missed call, answered before they call someone else."?

Start with `docs/quality-v2/FINAL_REVIEW.md`; `PROGRESS.md`, `REVIEW_PASS02.md` and `SCORECARD.md` are in the same folder.
